papers.title: An innovative hybrid optimization approach for sustainable milling of support structures in additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V components utilizing NSGA-III and COBRA
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Yildiz Technical University, Istanbul, 34349, Turkey

corresponding_authors.name: Ahmet Akçadırcı
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Yildiz Technical University, Istanbul, 34349, Turkey

papers.venue: The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关注增材制造Ti-6Al-4V支撑结构的铣削优化，而非材料本身的力学或疲劳性能。
llm.why_not_core: Paper focuses on optimizing milling parameters for support removal, not on mechanical/fatigue characterization or modeling of Ti-6Al-4V.

summary_zh.method: 结合NSGA-III和COBRA的混合优化方法
summary_zh.result: 优化铣削参数以提高可持续性

summary_en.motivation: To develop a sustainable milling strategy for support structures in additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V components.
summary_en.method: A hybrid optimization approach combining NSGA-III and COBRA algorithms is proposed.
summary_en.result: The optimized milling parameters enhance sustainability by reducing environmental impact.
summary_en.validation: Experimental milling tests validate the effectiveness of the optimization approach.
